next.reason: 1985: "The ',' (comma), 'B' (space), '0' (zero), and '/' (slant) are used as the insertion characters."; 2023: "Character-1 and the symbols 'B', '0', '/', ',' and, if literal=1 is specified, character-1 are used as the simple insertion editing symbols.". Size counting, trailing-comma placement and DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA swap carry over. 2023 adds character-1 (EDITING phrase literal-1) as a simple insertion symbol, a case 1985 lacks.
